description: RM3 two-body point absorber parameters for frequency-domain analysis

bodies.name: Float
bodies.mass_note: mass = rho * volume (body in static equilibrium)
bodies.C33_note: Hydrostatic stiffness nondimensionalized: C_bar = C / (rho * g). Dimensional C33 [N/m] = C33_nondim * rho * g

bodies.name: Spar/Plate
bodies.mass_note: mass = rho * volume (body in static equilibrium)
bodies.C33_note: Hydrostatic stiffness nondimensionalized: C_bar = C / (rho * g). Dimensional C33 [N/m] = C33_nondim * rho * g

pto.stiffness_note: PTO stiffness K_PTO = 0 N/m (pure damper configuration)
pto.damping_note: PTO damping B_PTO is the optimization variable [N/(m/s)]
pto.coupling: PTO acts on relative heave displacement between Float (DOF 3) and Spar (DOF 9)

nondimensionalization.source: WAMIT v7.2 output format with ULEN=1m
nondimensionalization.added_mass: A_bar = A_dim / rho. To dimensionalize: A_dim [kg] = A_bar * rho
nondimensionalization.radiation_damping: B_bar = B_dim / (rho * omega). To dimensionalize: B_dim [kg/s] = B_bar * rho * omega
nondimensionalization.excitation_force: F_bar = F_dim / (rho * g). To dimensionalize: F_dim [N/m_wave_amplitude] = F_bar * rho * g. Phase in degrees.
nondimensionalization.hydrostatic_stiffness: C_bar = C_dim / (rho * g). To dimensionalize: C_dim [N/m] = C_bar * rho * g

wave_spectrum.note: Standard Pierson-Moskowitz wave spectrum S(omega) parameterized by significant wave height Hs and peak period Tp. Use omega form (rad/s).

hydro_columns: omega[rad/s], A33_bar, B33_bar, A39_bar, B39_bar, A93_bar, B93_bar, A99_bar, B99_bar, |F3_bar|, Phase_F3[deg], |F9_bar|, Phase_F9[deg]
